decisions.business: Group to which each node belongs; node_groups[i]=1 means node i belongs to group 1, node_groups[i]=2 means node i belongs to group 2.
decisions.shape: list[int], length num_nodes; the i-th entry corresponds to zero-based node i.
decisions.completeness: Must contain exactly num_nodes entries, each of which must be 1 or 2, and both group 1 and group 2 must appear at least once; the total node weight of each group must not exceed bisection_capacity.

decisions.business: Cut indicators given in input edge order; cut_edges[e]=1 if and only if the two endpoints of edges[e] belong to different groups, otherwise 0.
decisions.shape: list[int], length num_edges; the e-th entry corresponds to the e-th undirected edge in the input.
decisions.completeness: Must contain exactly num_edges entries, each of which must be 0 or 1, and every entry must be exactly consistent with node_groups: 1 when the endpoint groups differ, 0 when they are the same.
